senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Palti, Paltiel, to whom Michal the daughter of Saul was given as wife, but who, according to tradition, did not live with her because of her betrothal to David.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 19b:21">Snh. 19ᵇ</cite>; v. <cite ref="Q00997"><he>פָּלַט</he></cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:10">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>; a. e.
